summary: Backend-only CLI testing for my-termux `my-media` friendly-error handling. Added 13 new pytest tests covering all 6 bug-fix scenarios (placeholder path with < or >, missing file, directory, KeyError for info/rm/attach/open) and all regression scenarios (valid add, empty list tip, list columns, cloud status/sync without creds). All 53 pre-existing tests still pass. Total: 66/66 passing.
critical_code_review_comments: cli.py cmd_media placeholder check `str(src).startswith('<') or '<' in str(src) or '>' in str(src)` — the `startswith('<')` clause is redundant since `'<' in str(src)` already covers it. Not a bug, just cleanup.

cli.py is now ~430 lines with cmd_media at ~100 lines handling 9 sub-actions. Consider extracting media action handlers into separate functions (e.g., _media_add, _media_info) for readability; still well under the 700-line file threshold so not urgent.

media.add() line 143 raises `FileNotFoundError('not a file: ...')` — cli.py catches it, but the error message from media.py isn't the friendliest if used outside cli. Consider having media.add distinguish 'file not found' vs 'is a directory' at the library level too (currently pre-checked only in the CLI).
seed_data_creation: None — each test uses the isolated_home fixture in conftest.py which provisions a fresh MYTERMUX_HOME per test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This project is a Termux CLI Python package under /app/mytermux/. Run tests with `python -m pytest tests/ -q` from /app/. Tests must NOT hit any HTTP endpoints — /app/backend and /app/frontend scaffolding is unused. Use the `isolated_home` fixture in /app/tests/conftest.py which resets MYTERMUX_HOME per test. New tests for CLI error paths live in /app/tests/test_media_errors.py. Cloudinary SDK is mocked via monkeypatch (see test_media_cloud.py helper `_install_fake_cloudinary`) — no real network.
rca of the issue: N/A — this was a verification pass. The main agent already fixed cmd_media in /app/mytermux/cli.py: (1) added a pre-check for '<' or '>' in the path to catch literal placeholder paths, (2) added explicit existence and is_dir checks producing friendly `[error]` messages before invoking media.add, (3) wrapped media.get()-driven subcommands (info/open/rm/attach) in try/except KeyError. All 13 new tests confirm the fixes work end-to-end via cli.main() with the correct exit codes and stdout substrings.
